hoy.titular: Correa tears a muscle: out of the Supercopa and a doubt for the final
hoy.resumen: The club confirmed a grade 2 muscle injury in Joaquín Correa's right hamstring. He misses Thursday's Supercopa and Medina hopes to have him for Palmeiras.
puntos: Supercopa tickets: online via Deportick, from ARS 65,000 to ARS 140,000, with ID.
Coaches to Montevideo (ARS 50,000 return, in the UNO app): Thursday 12 for members with 400+ points, Friday 13 for the rest, Saturday 14 general sale.
Baltasar Rodríguez is the man in line to replace Correa on Thursday. Palacios is carrying a knee niggle: if he doesn't make it, Rojo starts.

linea.texto: The squad train today and tomorrow at City Bell, travel to Córdoba on Wednesday afternoon and will stay at the Quinto Centenario hotel.
The reserves play San Martín (SJ) at the Country and look to move closer to the play-offs.
With Correa out, Baltasar Rodríguez looks set to return to the starting XI for the Supercopa.
Palmeiras, the top-scoring side, against one of the meanest defences: this is how the final shapes up.
Pope Leo XIV was given an Estudiantes shirt during his visit to Argentina.
Medical update: Correa has a grade 2 hamstring injury on his right leg, misses the Supercopa and is a doubt for the final.

pasos: Go to sumate.estudiantesdelaplata.com and enter your address: the system detects your area and works out your fee.
